acquisition.stated_local_download_date_provenance: Human-reported acquisition date; not independently proven by a retained dump archive in this repository.
acquisition.url_reproducibility_note: The /latest/ URL is a moving target. An immutable dated snapshot URL (e.g. https://dumps.wikimedia.org/nywiki/YYYYMMDD/nywiki-YYYYMMDD-pages-articles.xml.bz2) could not be derived because the original .bz2 archive is not retained in this repository and no dump-generation timestamp was preserved.

archive_evidence_in_repository.local_raw_notes: Repository retains extracted/cleaned text only, not the Wikimedia XML dump.

extraction_and_cleaning.extraction_method: Manual dump download followed by offline extraction to line-oriented text (not automated in this repository).
modifications_performed: XML/wiki markup extraction to plain text (prior to repository raw snapshot)
Cleaning Policy v2 line-level removals and transforms (boilerplate, foreign-language heuristics, URL handling, short-line rules, etc.)

also_available_under: GFDL (unversioned, no invariant sections) for compatible text; reusers may comply with CC BY-SA and/or GFDL per Wikimedia Terms of Use
license.copyright_holders: Individual Chichewa Wikipedia contributors retain copyright in their contributions; Wikimedia Foundation hosts the project and does not own all article copyrights.

attribution_requirements: Identify Chichewa Wikipedia (ny.wikipedia.org / nywiki) as the source
Provide CC BY-SA 4.0 license notice and link
Indicate that extraction and cleaning modifications were performed
Provide a reasonable attribution route to contributors (project URL and/or article history mechanism)
Do not imply endorsement by Wikimedia Foundation or Wikipedia
Do not claim Wikimedia Foundation owns all article copyrights
known_uncertainties: Exact dated Wikimedia dump snapshot (YYYYMMDD) cannot be proven from retained repository artifacts
Original nywiki-latest-pages-articles.xml.bz2 is not present; SHA-256 of the dump cannot be computed here
Reported MediaWiki generator and XML header fields are operator-reported, not re-read from a local archive
Local raw file is post-extraction text; pre-cleaning extraction pipeline is outside this repository's automated scripts

permissions_for_this_project.model_weight_note: CC BY-SA obligations for redistributed cleaned text do not automatically determine whether trained model weights are adapted material. No qualified legal advice has been obtained on that point.
